issue.title: memory leak `WARNING: invalid path to external symbolizer`

labels.name: type-bug
labels.description: An unexpected behavior, bug, or error

issue.body:
# Bug report

### Bug description:

```python
import unittest
from test import support
import operator

class MiscTest(unittest.TestCase):
    @support.infinite_recursion(None)
    def test_recursion(self):
        from collections import UserList
        a = UserList()
        b = UserList()
        a.append(b)
        b.append(a)
        self.assertRaises(RecursionError, operator.eq, a, b)
        self.assertRaises(RecursionError, operator.ne, a, b)
        self.assertRaises(RecursionError, operator.lt, a, b)
        self.assertRaises(RecursionError, operator.le, a, b)
        self.assertRaises(RecursionError, operator.gt, a, b)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main(verbosity=0)
```

comments.body:
I am quite unclear the root cause of this problem and if this is a cpython bug or not. Feel free to close this if it is not related. Another reproducer:
```python
import _thread
import threading

def task():
    threading.current_thread()   

_thread.start_new_thread(task, ())
```

I attempted to reproduce this memory leak but was unable to trigger it with the provided code. ASan reported no leaks.
Arch linux 64 bit
Is there a specific compile flag (like --enable-experimental-jit) required to reproduce this?
@YuanchengJiang Could you please share more details, or should we close this issue?
I'm unable to reproduce with the original repro, and no more details were provided, so I'm going to close.
